items.title: Space Parkour
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
HIGH DIFFICULTY!
Parkour your way through planets, satellites, space wreckage, and asteroid belts! Who among us can make it to the end? The dangers of space await you in this challenging parkour adventure.
+ Parkour
+ 10 levels
+ 4 skins that are OUT OF THIS WORLD!

items.title: Lucky Blocks.
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Lucky blocks add a block that drops random loot to your survival world. Do you dare break the blocks?

+ Lucky blocks provided and spawn naturally

items.title: Parkour Sky Islands
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Parkour is a minigame that focuses on jumping! Use parkour to traverse through islands in the sky and get to the end! Each section has its own style and convenient checkpoints in between to maintain your progress! With parkour difficulty increasing as you get farther into the map, you can test and grow your jumping skills in this fun map!

items.title: Grid Runners Pro
items.creator: Noxcrew
items.description:
Grid Runners is back, and now we’ve gone PRO. Craft, build, fight and parkour your way to victory with unique Minecraft challenge rooms and courses. Compete with your friends or against the clock to become the ultimate MC champion!

+Create custom courses and play your way
+Weird and wonderful Wacky Rooms
+BILLIONS of course combinations!

! Created by Noxcrew

items.title: PvP Teens
items.creator: Tetrascape
items.description:
Win your way to the top!
6 skins | Created by Tetrascape

items.title: Anime Explorers
items.creator: Diveblocks
items.description:
Anime Explorers skin pack opens a fascinating window into Minecraft's exciting adventures. Join your world and start a unique journey!

By Colibri Studios

items.title: Zombie Invasion
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
A powerful corporation of zombies has come to Minecraft that will invade the world with terror! Choose your Zombie!

- Two totally free skins
- Fourteen Skins
- Created by DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Spy Cats and Dogs
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Who doesn't love puppies and kittens? They are all so cute and cuddly! Now you can become one, but not only that, you will also be a spy; the perfect combination. Don't miss this great opportunity and become the best spy of all time! Enjoy these fabulous skins. 

- 2 free skins
- Created by DragonClub Studios

items.title: Rappers Nation
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Did you hear about the latest concerts in town? Everyone is going out and having fun, feeling life at its fullest, and trying all kinds of new stuff. So hang out with your friends in your free time and be if you're lucky enough, maybe a famous rapper could give his most significant break! Stay tuned!

+ 1 free skin
+ 15 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Ice Cream!
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Summertime's here and you need somethin' to keep you cool... Lucky you, the ice cream man is passin' by!
There's cones, popsicle, cups and sorbets too!
All the flavors are guaranteed to satisfy!

- 10 funny and refreshing HD ice cream-shaped skins!
- A unique looking design!
- Perfect to attract all eyes on you!
- By Pixelusion

items.title: Parkour Dimensions: Overworld
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Parkour is a minigame all about jumping! Use parkour skills and beat an overworld-themed map! This map features creative jumps and a detailed map that you will have so much fun conquering! 

+ Explore a beautifully crafted parkour adventure
+ Great for any skill level

items.title: Millionaire Beachfront Hotel
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Experience a luxurious vacation with room for all of your friends at this tropical beachfront hotel! Choose to swim with the dolphins in the ocean, or take a dip in the courtyard pool!

+ Giant hotel
+ Tropical beach
+ Sand volleyball court
+ By ArgoStudios and 4KS Studios

items.title: Destiny Island
items.creator: Builders Horizon
items.description: Custom survival island spawn with houses! +Custom survival island village +Custom island terrain +Lots of Isle houses!

items.title: Demon Lords
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: Rule over all, in these stylish demon skins!

items.title: Millionaire Mansion
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: A millionaire should play survival in a mansion! Enjoy this custom world with its many decorated rooms!

items.title: Nether Creeps
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
Deep within the nether exists creatures of complete darkness. For too long they have been isolated from the rest of the world. Now...that they have been unearthed by accident. They plan to unleash chaos in the nether! Are you ready?

- 8 skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: Dragons Fly
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description: Dragons fly high up in the skies! Join them among the clouds. These skins can be perfect for dragon roleplaying or even skyblock adventures.

items.title: MC Animals Pack
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description: There are so many cute animals in Minecraft! Here in this skin pack you'll find a good selection of adorable critters to roleplay as! Become a moo moo or maybe a clucking chicken. There's also a cute bat or maybe an orange fox will be your choice! Which adorable animal skin will you pick today?

items.title: ONE BLOCK SKYBLOCK
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
One block and skyblock!

One block adds a new block each time it breaks! Skyblock has evolved!

items.title: Billionaire Island
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Have fun in this majestic haven where you can own 6 luxurious yachts, expensive cars and 3 extravagant mansions. Play on creative mode to build your own mansion and decorate it with over 117 items to choose and then switch to survival to enjoy roleplaying. Live your fancy with Billionaire Island!

- Custom models
- Custom vehicles
- Prefect for roleplay
- Four Skins

items.title: Teen Axolotl
items.creator: DogHouse
items.description:
Do you like Axolotls? Then you need this skin pack! Choose your favorite costume from 12 different skins. Impress your friends with a new look and feel like a real Axolotl!

- 12 different Axolotl skins
- Perfect for roleplay!
- Have fun

items.title: Superpower Villagers
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Protect your village from the creatures! Choose the skin you want from these cool villagers with superpowers and start becoming a hero.

- 12 epic powerful villager skins
- 2 free skin!
- By Pixelusion & xfaddy

items.title: Kawaii Anime Teens
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Cute anime is everyone's all-time favorite! Cool-looking skins that will attract attention wherever you go!

- 21 cool anime skins
- 1 free skin
- By Pixelusion and Lostduckies

items.title: Sirenhead Mutants
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Get ready for the muted siren heads! These famous creatures have mutated and their heads evolved into other things. From now, survivors will face a new threat. Choose your favorite skin and spook your friends!

+ Monsters
+ Scary
+ Horrors
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine
